course_name_original: Diseño de estructuras y construcciones industriales
course_name_en: Design of industrial structures and constructions

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamentals of calculating metal structures
Understand the usual configurations of metal structures
Understand the joining methods of metal structures and their calculation fundamentals
Understand the functioning of support devices for metal structures
Understand the bases for the execution, control, and maintenance of metal structures
Understand the composition of reinforced concrete and its use as a construction material
Know how concrete is prepared and how it is placed on site
Identify the main characteristics of reinforcements for reinforced concrete
Describe the environment a concrete structure will be subjected to and decide the best strategy for its durability
Dimension or check reinforced concrete sections subjected to normal stresses
Analyze a reinforced concrete section against shear force

assessment_rules: The course is evaluated through two blocks: metal structures and reinforced concrete, each graded from 0 to 5. The total grade is the sum of both block grades, with a minimum of 2 out of 5 required in each block for compensability. A total grade of 5 or higher is required to pass. If the total grade is 5 or more but one block is not passed and could not be compensated, the final grade will be 4.9.
